title: IP functions will soon be available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled
body:
IP functions will be available by default for workspaces with the [compliance security profile](/aws/en/security/privacy/security-profile) enabled.

Use IP functions to work with IP addresses and CIDR blocks, including joins on IP addresses and CIDR blocks.

See [IP functions](/aws/en/sql/language-manual/sql-ref-ip-functions).
